headline: Frankie — this is the only brief you'll get today, and that's the story. At 12:38 AM UTC the cofounder sweep fired; at 1:09 AM the AM brief fired; both ran exactly on schedule and both wrote nothing to your Mac. Meeting-ingest emailed at 12:03 AM that it couldn't reach the workspace at all — its second night in a row. The only reason you're reading anything is that this PM session happens to have Mac access. So today kills the two theories we kept reaching for: it isn't the scheduler (everything fired on cron, in the right order) and it isn't the API balance (a $0 balance can't explain a task that runs fine and still can't write). It's one thing — the cloud-to-Mac bridge — and the fix is to rebuild the brief pipeline, the sweep and meeting-ingest as LOCAL tasks. Everything else is where it was six hours ago, only older: the ads are blind five days now on 0/7 compliance, EIN is 60 days silent, and the booking funnel logged a fourth straight day of zero real leads.
